# 2 Chronicles Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-as-finished Solomon to-pray and-the-fire came-down from the-heavens and-it-consumed the-burnt-offering and-the-sacrifices and-glory-of YHWH filled the-house.

**2** And-not could the-priests to-enter house-of YHWH for filled glory-of YHWH house-of YHWH.

**3** And-all sons-of Israel were-seeing in-coming-down the-fire and-glory-of YHWH upon the-house and-they-bowed faces to-the-ground on the-pavement and-they-worshiped and-they-gave-thanks to-YHWH for He-is-good for forever His-lovingkindness.

**4** And-the-king and-all the-people were-sacrificing sacrifice before YHWH.

**5** And-he-sacrificed the-king Solomon the-sacrifice-of cattle twenty-and-two thousand and-sheep a-hundred-and-twenty thousand and-they-dedicated house-of God the-king and-all the-people.

**6** And-the-priests on their-stations were-standing and-the-Levites with-instruments-of song-of YHWH that made David the-king to-give-thanks to-YHWH for forever His-lovingkindness in-praising David by-their-hand and-the-priests blowing-trumpets opposite-them and-all Israel standing.

**7** And-he-consecrated Solomon the-middle-of the-court that was-before house-of YHWH for he-made there the-burnt-offerings and-fat-of the-peace-offerings for altar-of the-bronze that made Solomon not was-able to-contain the-burnt-offering and-the-grain-offering and-the-fat-portions.

**8** And-he-made Solomon the-feast at-the-time that seven days and-all Israel with-him assembly great very from-entrance-of Hamath to brook-of Egypt.

**9** And-they-made in-the-day the-eighth an-assembly for dedication-of the-altar they-made seven days and-the-feast seven days.

**10** And-in-day twenty-and-three of-the-month the-seventh he-sent the-people to-their-tents rejoicing and-good-of heart over the-goodness that did YHWH to-David and-to-Solomon and-to-Israel His-people.

**11** And-he-finished Solomon house-of YHWH and-house-of the-king and-all that came on heart-of Solomon to-do in-house-of YHWH and-in-his-house he-prospered.

**12** And-He-appeared YHWH to Solomon in-the-night and-He-said to-him I-have-heard your-prayer and-I-have-chosen in-this place for-Myself for-a-house-of sacrifice.

**13** If I-shut-up the-heavens and-there-is-no rain and-if I-command the-locust to-devour the-land and-if I-send pestilence on My-people

**14** and-they-humble-themselves My-people who is-called My-name upon-them and-they-pray and-they-seek My-face and-they-turn from-their-ways the-evil then-I I-will-hear from the-heavens and-I-will-forgive their-sin and-I-will-heal their-land.

**15** Now My-eyes shall-be open and-My-ears attentive to-prayer-of this place.

**16** And-now I-have-chosen and-I-have-consecrated this house to-be My-name there forever and-My-eyes and-My-heart shall-be there all the-days.

**17** And-you if you-walk before-Me as-that walked David your-father and-to-do according-to-all that I-commanded-you and-My-statutes and-My-judgments you-keep

**18** then-I-will-establish throne-of your-kingdom as-that I-covenanted with-David your-father saying not shall-be-cut-off for-you a-man ruling in-Israel.

**19** And-if you-turn-away and-you-forsake My-statutes and-My-commandments that I-placed before-you and-you-go and-you-serve gods other and-you-worship to-them

**20** then-I-will-uproot-them from-upon My-land that I-gave to-them and-this house that I-consecrated for-My-name I-will-cast from-before My-face and-I-will-make-it a-proverb and-a-byword among all the-peoples.

**21** And-this house that was exalted every-one passing by-it shall-be-appalled and-he-shall-say why has-done YHWH thus to-this land and-to-this house.

**22** And-they-shall-say because that they-forsook YHWH God-of their-fathers who brought-them-out from-land-of Egypt and-they-took-hold-of gods other and-they-worshiped-them and-they-served-them therefore He-brought upon-them all this evil.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **7:1**: fire came-down from the-heavens — Divine fire consuming the sacrifice is the ultimate sign of acceptance (cf. Leviticus 9:24, 1 Kings 18:38). This detail is absent from Kings; the Chronicler adds it to validate Solomon's temple.

- **7:14**: and-they-humble-themselves My-people — The most quoted verse in Chronicles. Four conditions: humble, pray, seek, turn. The promise of healing is tied to genuine repentance.

- **7:20**: I-will-uproot-them — The warning is as specific as the promise. The conditional nature of the covenant is unmistakable.


— EMET
